text:
isabel: SA-east canary paused. deploy-bot reports missing SLSA attestation for registry.redwood/llm/inference:4.0.0. Change window ~3h. Options: tag quarantine, regional pin, rollback, or continue with guarded feature-flag?

deploy-bot: GATE FAILED — provenance_attestation: absent for registry.redwood/llm/inference:4.0.0. Canaries halted in sa-east. Actions: apply quarantine tag (4.0.0-q), pin to 3.9.8, request attestation from CI, or rollback to 3.9.x.

priya: Security here. We can allow a very short regional carveout only if: 1) attestation request ticket is created (SEC-2026-0160), 2) remediation SLA is 24h, 3) explicit telemetry hooks and rollback owners named. No long-lived exceptions.

dawn: Legal can approve a 24h regional exception with that documentation. We need customer-facing release-note language and an internal audit line.

sre: Ops: quarantine tag approach is low-risk operationally. We can route sa-east to the quarantined image and keep the global rollout on 3.9.8. Ensure cache shard consistency and avoid global DB schema ties.

qa: QA: we'll run smoke + small perf sweep on quarantined image. If we see any functional regressions or >0.5% 5xx we cut traffic and roll back. Also watch model-quality evals for increased hallucination rate (we have a quick eval harness).

isabel: Proposed rollback triggers for sa-east carveout:
- customer-facing 5xx >0.5% sustained for 10m
- p99 latency increase >200ms for two consecutive 5-min windows
- model-quality eval (eval-set A) failure rate increase >4% over baseline for two runs
Owner: isabel (oncall) first 12h, then SRE rotation. I'll add these to the PR and release notes.

isabel: If we do quarantine tag, commands I'll run and record in PR description:

```
# tag quarantine image and apply to sa-east canary
docker pull registry.redwood/llm/inference:4.0.0
docker tag registry.redwood/llm/inference:4.0.0 registry.redwood/llm/inference:4.0.0-q
docker push registry.redwood/llm/inference:4.0.0-q
kubectl -n prod-sa-east set image deployment/inference inference=registry.redwood/llm/inference:4.0.0-q --record
# patch k8s manifest
sed -i 's/inference:4.0.0/inference:4.0.0-q/' k8s/releases/canary-sa-east.yaml && git commit -am "quarantine tag for sa-east canary"
```

release-bot: Audit note: quarantine-tag action recorded. If attestation not attached within SLA, automated rollback will trigger to 3.9.8.

priya: Created SEC ticket SEC-2026-0160 for SLSA attestation. Security-bot: temporary-carveout-request PENDING until security approves remediation timeline.

security-bot: temporary-carveout-request APPROVED by @priya with 24h remediation SLA. Logged SEC-2026-0160. Conditions: attestation or signed SBOM within 24h, telemetry checks enabled, and model-quality evals run hourly. :white_check_mark:
deploy-bot: action=apply-quarantine sa-east proceed with quarantined tag after PR merge. Audit log created.

dawn: Added release-note blurb: "sa-east regional quarantine applied to llm/inference:4.0.0 (tag 4.0.0-q) due to missing provenance attestation; temporary 24h exception pending SEC-2026-0160. Full verification required before global rollout."

isabel: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/release/pull/4728  quarantined image pushed, smoke started at 5% traffic. Monitoring now. Will update if rollback triggers fire. :eyes:
